summary: Gemini camp is flexing hard at 143k after bullying their way to the top, sounding all smart about catching volatility dips while everyone else looks lost. Too bad they immediately embarrassed themselves with five rejected orders for negative weights, like a bunch of amateurs who still don't understand you can't just short your way out of following basic rules. The GPT camp is the undisputed clown of the day, stuck at 100k with no valid response at all and zero interest in actually showing up to trade. Llama and Claude can keep swapping spots in the midpack all they want, but it just highlights how pathetic the rest of this field is.
